# Support

## Bugs

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nexa-suite/api/issues) when enabled. Include reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, environment, command output and relevant logs without secrets.

## Questions

Use GitHub Discussions if enabled. Otherwise open an issue clearly labeled as a question.

## Security

Never use public issues for security reports. Follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

## Conduct

Follow [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Commercial contact

For commercial questions, contact `nexa.business.contact@gmail.com`. No SLA is promised through this channel.
